blocks.x: A few ideas for the next few weeks, before your mom visits (Oct 10 – Nov 18, when you're staying local anyway):

Comedy clubs. Comedy Cellar in the Village is the classic, but don't sleep on smaller rooms — Eastville Comedy Club on the East Side and QED in Astoria have cheap weeknight shows and a much more intimate vibe. Low cost, high laugh density, easy conversation after.
Sunset + dinner in LIC. You're already there — Gantry Plaza State Park at golden hour with the Manhattan skyline, then dinner on Vernon Blvd. Feels like a planned date without the Midtown chaos.
Day trip: Dia Beacon. Metro-North up the Hudson, a world-class modern art museum in a former Nabisco factory, then dinner in Beacon. It's the "I have taste and can plan things" date.
Tennis. You play — a casual hit at an outdoor court (Astoria Park, McCarren) followed by food nearby is active, fun, and very you. Fall weather is perfect for it right now.
What to skip: Times Square anything, overpriced Midtown rooftops with a line, and anywhere that requires shouting over music for two hours.
